_comment: Predicts H100's forward-pass time at n=8192 using ONLY V100 and A100's real measured data plus all three GPUs' public peak specs -- H100's own real timing (included below only for comparison) is never used to produce its own prediction. This exact configuration reproduces one of the 15 held-out points reported in this project's position paper, Section 6.3 (published error: 50.21%).
